jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production animation sprite sheet for the EXISTING orange tabby cat adventurer in reference image. Preserve exactly his species, proportions, orange stripes, cream muzzle, red neckerchief, off-white rolled-sleeve shirt, brown leather vest and small backpack, olive trousers and brown boots. Keep the small sword safely LOW in the same hand. Warm hand-painted anime game art, clean fine outlines, soft shading, never pixel art. Transparent background, NO ground or shadows, no captions, labels, grid lines, border, extra objects or cropped limbs. Camera elevated orthographic about 35 degrees downward. ALL drawings on this sheet face ONE IDENTICAL locked direction: southeast: a three-quarter FRONT view facing diagonally toward the lower RIGHT of the screen. Both eyes visible, nose points right. Layout is EXACTLY FOUR equal-width columns by FIVE equal-height rows, twenty separate complete figures, one centered figure in each cell, consistent figure scale and shared boot-contact baseline within every row. Clear transparent gutters; never overlap cells. Read frames left-to-right, then next row. Rows 1 and 2 form ONE anatomically coherent 8-frame WALK cycle: left contact, left down, left passing, left up, right contact, right down, right passing, right up. Alternate the planted leg, heel-to-toe foot roll, opposing arm swing, flexible knees, subtle pelvis/head bob, delayed tail/scarf motion. Rows 3 and 4 form a DIFFERENT 8-frame RUN cycle in the same frame order, with a forward lean, deeper knee bend, stronger opposite arm swing, and airborne passing poses. Row 5 is four gentle IDLE frames: relaxed eyes open, soft inhale, a brief eyes-closed blink, relaxed exhale. Do not repeat the same stance across the movement frames. The first and last cycle poses connect smoothly; no pose is a turnaround. Figures remain in place on the page, with no drawn travel path. Clothing, head size and equipment remain identical throughout. Allocate enough room per cell for every tail, sword tip, boot and ear.
